description: Start billed asynchronous enrichment of an entity list against exactly one of schema_id or target_schema. Returns job_id and total. No fixed entity-count cap; live prompt quotas and credits can stop remaining work. Each entity follows the enrichment/fusion pipeline; every model must succeed for its automatic fusion and database admission. A confident classification mismatch skips that entity without enrichment, never pauses the batch. Poll get_job_status, then list_records(job_id=...). Attachments apply to every entity. Unlike enrich_entity, this tool does not expose database_sync=false. By default the job runs on YOUR model (use_platform_models=false, no explicit model): its entities park their calls as llm_requests, several at once, and enable_web_search must be decided (omitted returns web_search_undecided). Input contracts, partial results and recovery: enricher://docs/batch-enrichment.

arbitration_model.description: Optional LLM for auto-fusion conflict resolution (None = rule-based).
arbitration_model.title: Arbitration Model

attachment_ids.description: Attachment UUIDs applied as source material to every entity.
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

classification_model.description: Optional classifier key. Confident mismatches skip that entity; softer verdicts become prompt context. Batch classification never pauses.
classification_model.title: Classification Model

enable_web_search.description: On your model (the default), true asks you to ground the answers with your own web search tool and false not to; omitted returns web_search_undecided so you ask the user first. On platform models, true enables the provider's builtin search where the model supports it (omitted = false).
enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search

entities.description: Entities to enrich (each a free-form dict naming the entity — the schema's identifying fields ideally, but any field names work).
entities.title: Entities

models.description: Model composite keys; omit (or pass ['auto']) for one automatically selected model: YOUR model, or with use_platform_models=true the organization's best model for enrichment from its benchmark scores (quality/speed/cost weights), within the run's constraints (attachments, web search, thinking) — the result reports the pick as model_selection. auto alone never fuses. Name provider::model keys only when the user named them; that runs the job on the platform (billed), and two or more fuse. Keys and model-count limits: list_models.
models.title: Models

reasoning_effort.description: Thinking (reasoning) opt-in: low, medium or high; omitted = off. On the platform, auto then picks only a model whose reasoning the platform can pilot, and the effort is translated per provider. On YOUR model, apply the effort yourself when you run the requests.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

schema_id.description: UUID of a saved schema. Mutually exclusive with target_schema.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

target_schema.description: Inline schema document in the supported Entity Enricher dialect. Prefer schema_id to link records. See enricher://docs/schema-reference.
target_schema.title: Target Schema

use_platform_models.description: false (default): every LLM call of this job runs on YOUR model — the job parks each call as a pending request you answer with answer_llm_request; no credits are consumed. true: the job runs on the platform (billed) and, with the model left on auto, on the organization's best model for the task — its highest blended benchmark score under the organization's quality/speed/cost weights, among the models that satisfy the run (attachments, web search, thinking). Naming a platform model also runs the job there, bypassing that pick: do it only when the user named one. Protocol: enricher://docs/llm-delegation.
use_platform_models.title: Use Platform Models
